# V0.7.11-12

Section: Source

**V0.7.11-12** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on June 16th, 2019.

## V0.7.11

- Fix - reduced mechanical friction of electric motors, increased resistance of generators

## V0.7.12

- Fix - increased battery capacity 400%
